Production GPU median 33.912 ms, wait-gpu 0.384 ms. Weight addressing is the only existential bucket (21.293 ms, 60.4% of wall). It is DRAM traffic: addr_probe is 83-92% of every GEMV class. top_three_attacks.mechanism: Fewer weight bytes (BPW). Weight addressing is 21.293 ms of sequential Q4 DRAM traffic; addr_probe is 87% of MLP, 91% of DeltaNet GEMVs, 83% of GQA GEMVs, 92% of lm_head. geo_tpr64_tg128 already launches 8704 TGs on the 17408-row gate (145 TGs/core) — not occupancy-starved. Production token is at 401.6 / 411.51 GB/s = 97.6% of the honest decode ceiling.
top_three_attacks.expected_ns_recovered: At 2.0 / 4.2527 BPW the addressing bucket scales to ~10.01 ms (recover ~11.28 ms). Decode + GEMV FMA scale with it: ~12.5 ms total from the GEMV-traffic class. This is the only existential lever. Do not shave microseconds on #2/#3 while this stands.

top_three_attacks.mechanism: Fuse DeltaNet activation tails. Isolated gated_rmsnorm is 1.308 ms for 48 launches of 16-wide reductions; ba_to_decay 0.139 ms; rearrange leftover after conv-state stream ~0.33 ms. These are launch + low-occupancy ALU, 223× their bandwidth floor.
top_three_attacks.expected_ns_recovered: 1.0–1.5 ms if gated_rmsnorm + ba + rearrange fuse into the vi kernel or one encoder. Cannot go below the rec-state floor already parked in kv_state (0.47 ms).

top_three_attacks.mechanism: Collapse 129 RMSNorms (input 1.137 ms + post 1.213 ms + final 0.019 ms). 122× bandwidth floor. Same story as GQA rope (1.557 ms / 16 layers at 24 threads): encoder-per-tiny-kernel tax.
top_three_attacks.expected_ns_recovered: 1.2–1.8 ms by folding RMSNorm into the following GEMV or sharing one persistent encoder. GQA rope is the alternate 1.2 ms if norms are left alone.

action: G016 density on the 13.618 GB active budget is the only attack that moves a millisecond-class EXISTENTIAL bucket. Fusion of DeltaNet tails and RMSNorms is queued behind it. Do not optimize the Q4 representation itself — uniform-q4-v1 is an oracle.
